description: 1.6A 22uH ±20% 1.9A Magnetic Shielded Inductor SMD,5x5mm Fixed Inductors RoHS
notes: Isat is 1.62 A MAX (the 1.9 A quoted earlier was the typ column) against a 1.18 A peak - 1.38x, below the 1.5x bar. Replaced by a 10 uH part at 2.9 A Isat, with the converter moved to ~1 MHz to hold the same ripple.
22 uH, 1.6 A rated, 1.9 A saturation, magnetic shielded, 5x5 mm, 19k stock, $0.054.

Value from L = Vout(Vin-Vout)/(Vin x f x dIL) at 36 V in, 5 V out, ~500 kHz, giving ~39% ripple at 1 A. Confirm against the RT resistor once the switching frequency is fixed - the TPS54360B is adjustable 100-2500 kHz and 22 uH assumes ~500 kHz.

5 V rail budget: 491 mA feeding the SY8089 for the 3.3 V rail, plus up to 480 mA of status LEDs, plus ~10 mA of buffer = 0.98 A worst case, 1.13 A peak with ripple. Against 1.9 A saturation that is 1.7x margin worst case, 2.5x typical.
SHIELDED matters here, not just for EMI: an unshielded inductor on a vibrating soundwall is also a mechanical and acoustic concern.
The 480 mA worst case assumes all 8 status LEDs at full white. Capping status brightness in firmware would make this comfortably irrelevant - they are indicators, not illumination.
